notes: hours=0 disables wall-clock stopping; max_steps is a safety cap, not proof of convergence.
Control strength=0 and candidate strength=1 share source online weights, data, noise and schedules.
Latent change is a proxy, not independent object-motion annotation. No smoothing loss is added.
Plateau concerns supervised denoising, not guaranteed generated RGB or motion quality.
GT-assisted oracle clips are diagnostics only and must never be presented as generated samples.
